meta.name: Debipokkho
meta.description: Ishani returns to the Sheel mansion when a sacred golden tongue goes missing, only to be blamed for the theft. As another shocking secret comes to light, she finds herself trapped among a family full of hidden motives. Two wills and a sinister riddle could change her fate forever.

videos.title: Churir Daye
videos.overview: Ishani returns to the Sheel mansion when a sacred golden tongue goes missing, only to be blamed for the theft. As another shocking secret comes to light, she finds herself trapped among a family full of hidden motives. Two wills and a sinister riddle could change her fate forever.

videos.title: Jib Jighangsha
videos.overview: Raghunath's lifeless body is found with a severed tongue. Now, the deadly suspicion for this murder falls on Ishani.

videos.title: Prakton
videos.overview: The whole house is shaken by police questioning when Ishani's ex-husband Prosen arrives with a woman by his side.

videos.title: Jhumjhumi Rohoshyo
videos.overview: Everyone's under house arrest by police. Continuing Durga Puja sparks a bitter debate between Madhabi and Adinath.

videos.title: Jento Kali
videos.overview: Is there a clue to the murder in Jhumpa's odd rhyme? Meanwhile, a new mystery brews, where was Prosen that night?

videos.title: Jora Will
videos.overview: Under Adinath's tough condition, Prosen sets a new trap. Meanwhile, Ishani and Madhabi find a mysterious note.

videos.title: Ghyachang
videos.overview: Blood is scattered all around, but Jhumpa is missing. Did the ruthless killer find a new victim in this dark house?

videos.title: Dhandha Bohurupi
videos.overview: The will's puzzle deepens the ultimate mystery. Raghunath actually asked Ishani for help. But who is the real killer?
